layout.hierarchy: The title 'Precision' dominates visually due to size and red color. The definition box and meaning box are secondary headers. The confusion matrices and tree diagrams on the right are distinct visual blocks.

visual_elements.description: Fraction-style definition box. Top part: 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)'. Bottom part separated by red line: 'Total Classified as Positive (either Correct and Erroneous)'.
Yellow background box. Header 'Meaning' in red bold. Text: '% of what you Predicted as POSITIVE is Actually Positive'. 'Predicted' is red, 'POSITIVE' is blue.
Red bordered box containing formula: 'Precision = TP / TP + FP'.
Blue bordered box containing calculation: 'Precision= 5/(5+0)' on first line, '= 100%' on second line.

Two beige speech bubbles connected by a green curly bracket. Left bubble: 'Positive Classified as +ive'. Right bubble: 'Negative Classified as +ive'. Text below bracket: 'All Samples classified as Positive' (with 'classified' in red).
Light blue bordered box with quote text. 'Whatever objects you retrieved as positive, I can trust you'. Second line in red italics: '(Irrespective of how many MISSED Positive samples)'.
Confusion matrix grid. Header 'Predicted as'. Columns P, N. Rows Actual P, N. Cells: Row P Col P: 'TP' (green bg). Row P Col N: 'FN'. Row N Col P: 'FP'. Row N Col N: 'TN' (green bg).

Confusion matrix grid with numbers. Header 'Predicted as'. Columns P, N. Rows Actual P, N. Cells: Row P Col P: '5' (blue circle). Row P Col N: '25'. Row N Col P: '0' (orange circle). Row N Col N: '70' (green bg).

Tree diagram labeled 'Positive' in red. Root node red circle '30'. Left child red circle '5' labeled 'TP'. Right child green circle '25' labeled 'FN'. Red arrows point outward from leaf nodes. Airplane icon above root.

Tree diagram labeled 'Negative' in green. Root node green circle '70'. Left child green circle '70' labeled 'TN'. Right child red circle '0' labeled 'FP'. Red arrows point outward from leaf nodes. Airplane icon above root.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large, bold, red, Title Case. Body text is black. Some words are emphasized in red or blue. No all-caps except for specific emphasis words like 'POSITIVE' and 'MISSED'.
animation_state: Static slide, no mid-build elements visible.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light grey (#F2F2F2). 2. Add title 'Precision' in large bold red font centered at top. 3. Add slide number '9' in a yellow circle at top right. 4. Create left column: Add grey fraction box with numerator 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)' and denominator 'Total Classified as Positive (either Correct and Erroneous)'. 5. Add yellow box below with header 'Meaning' and text '% of what you Predicted as POSITIVE is Actually Positive' (color 'Predicted' red, 'POSITIVE' blue). 6. Add red bordered box with formula 'Precision = TP / TP + FP'. 7. Add blue bordered box with text 'Precision= 5/(5+0)' and '= 100%'. 8. Add speech bubble diagram with bubbles 'Positive Classified as +ive' and 'Negative Classified as +ive', connected by green bracket labeled 'All Samples classified as Positive'. 9. Add bottom left blue box with quote 'Whatever objects you retrieved as positive, I can trust you' and red text '(Irrespective of how many MISSED Positive samples)'. 10. Create right column top: Two confusion matrices. First matrix labels TP, FN, FP, TN with green highlights on TP and TN. Second matrix with values 5 (blue circle), 25, 0 (orange circle), 70 (green bg). 11. Create right column bottom: Two tree diagrams. Left tree 'Positive': root 30 (red), children 5 (red, TP) and 25 (green, FN). Right tree 'Negative': root 70 (green), children 70 (green, TN) and 0 (red, FP). Add airplane icons above both trees.
